overclaims: The April 16, 2025 Photoroom interview quotes its CEO describing the company as financially secure, but supplies no defined profit measure or full-year 2025 accounts [e2].
checks.note: The Anthropic figures ($42.0B 2025 net loss, $34.3B fair-value changes) match e1. The rationale says Tech.eu 'quotes' Photoroom's CEO. The article only reports him indirectly ('He also points out that... Photoroom is one of the few which is financially secure'), so 'financially secure' may be the reporter's wording. Change this to 'reports its CEO describing'. Excerpt, proposition, axis, outcome and citations are otherwise correct.

Excerpt matches. The proposition drops 'absolutely' without changing the meaning. The Uber gross-basis/cost-of-revenue statement matches the e1 context, which limits it to markets where Uber provides the services. The Sonnet 4.5 $3/$15 pricing and Sep 29, 2025 date match e2. Limitations are appropriately hedged. Axis, horizon and outcome match the reviews.

The CoreWeave Nov 12, 2025 lender list, the OpenAI Oct 3, 2024 undrawn facility and the BoE Dec 2, 2025 warning all match the evidence. The BoE paraphrase shortens the asset-correction conditional without changing the meaning. The proposition leaves out the aggressive-lending clause, but it appears in the speaker criteria and the support condition. Citations and dates are correct.

The excerpt is a verbatim mid-sentence fragment. 'Every bit of AI demand' is shown in the criteria, so it is not misleading. The antecedent condition is shown. The H1 2026 net-loss and adjusted-operating-income statements are supported by e1 and its explanation. Forecast axis, open horizon and unresolved outcome match the reviews. Citation dates are correct.
